title: Autumn Empanada Filling with Apple
description: A unique twist on a traditional Japanese dessert, combining the flavors of autumn with the warmth of empanadas.

ingredients.name: Apples
ingredients.notes: Granny Smith or other firm variety

instructions: Peel, core, and chop the apples into 1-inch pieces.
Mix brown sugar, cinnamon, and allspice in a bowl.
Add the apple pieces to the bowl and toss until coated.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut into 4-6 triangles.
Place a tablespoon of apple mixture onto one half of each triangle.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a triangle and press edges to seal.
Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown.
Serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream, if desired.
